_doc: HudReveal's table, the only HUD reveal gate. from_match: the expedition the group shows from (0 = only by its first event). every_match: counted by the save in every match type (duel, training, tutorial too), not only staged expeditions, with no Tab or Show full HUD bypass.

vitals.what: health, level and the XP bar

abilities.what: ability row and the weapon card with their keys

beat_clock.what: the match clock under the minimap, from the first Ways Out beat or the first kill

summon_ring.what: the Boki box (and glove slots) and its summon ring

seat_pips.what: the Ways Out strip's seat pips, from the first open seat; the strip itself waits (every match) until a seat is lead_s seconds from opening or open, in use, taken or lost, and always shows for a player who is out

belt.what: the utility belt, from the first time a held item could be used

belt_spare.what: belt slots 3 and 4 while they are empty (a filled one always shows)

ult_tiles.what: the locked ultimate tiles (X, and the Fusion box) until level 6

pace_tags.what: ahead / behind pace tags (no widget yet)

kit_card.what: the 'Your kit' button card for show_s seconds after landing (the training room keeps it up and shows it from match 1)

own_numbers.what: your own kills, knocks and gems; before, from the first one or while Tab / the map key is held

newcomer_goal.what: the objective line may point at any seat; before, in a staged expedition only, at hud_groups.json newcomer_seats (HudReveal.newcomer)
